turn.content: The invoice is dated 2026-09-21, but the contract price of 842400 only takes effect 2026-09-28, and clause #2.2 says changes are never retroactive. So the PO price 739700 applies on the invoice date.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "contract_price_not_yet_effective", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0258", "detail": "Line 1 'Black Laser Printer Toner' ordered at unit price 739700."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-036#11.1", "detail": "Addendum No. 1: from 2026-09-28 the toner unit price changes to 842400."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-036#2.2", "detail": "A price change takes effect only through a written addendum and never retroactively."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "KOS-26-00682", "detail": "Invoice date 2026-09-21, i.e. before the addendum's effective date; line 1 billed at 842400."}], "explanation": "The invoice bills the addendum price of 842400 for toner on an invoice dated 2026-09-21, but that price only takes effect on 2026-09-28 and cannot apply retroactively, so the PO price of 739700 governs this invoice."}]}
